The registry cannot have issued this individnummer/year combination at all, which is a different failure from an impossible calendar date: the century resolver finds no row to resolve against, rather than resolving to a date that does not exist.

generated.csv's fnr-499-000 row (individual 250) ends 33, the correct check digits for 189188250; this ends 32, one digit changed on purpose. No bearer can exist for two independent reasons: the written month is still 91 (11 + 80), Skatteetaten's synthetic marker -- see spec/sources/norway-synthetic/README.md -- and the check digits are wrong regardless. Norway's checksum is verified before the synthetic gate is even consulted, so this fails with ChecksumMismatch rather than SyntheticNumber, whether or not allowSyntheticNumbers is set.

The single most valuable Norwegian fixture: individnummer 523 and two-digit year 76 read as 1876 here, under Folkeregisterhåndboken § 2-2-1's fødselsnummer table (500-749, year 54-99 -> 1800s). The same individnummer and year, written as a D-number instead (no-d-number-and-national-identity-number-share-individual-and-year-but-not-century, input 49867652301), read as 2076 under § 2-2-2's D-number table (500-999, any year -> 2000s) -- 200 years apart on identical digits. A merged century table would produce one wrong-but-plausible answer for every D-number in the 500-999 series instead of two independently-correct ones. referenceDate is 2090-01-01 rather than this file's usual 2026-08-16 so that the D-number sibling's 2076 birth date is not rejected as a future birth date -- this fixture's own 1876 result is unaffected by the change, since 1876 precedes both reference dates.

Written month 93 (13 + 80) -- see spec/sources/norway-synthetic/README.md's '+80 convention' section. The convention only ever encodes a real calendar month 1-12, written 81-92; 93 is one past that range and decodes to no calendar month either way: not directly, since 93 is not a month, and not after removing the +80 offset either, since 13 is not a month. No bearer can exist for that reason, distinct from every other fixture in this file, whose written months (81-92) are genuine +80 encodings of a real month. allowSyntheticNumbers is left at its default (false, unset here) and makes no difference to this value either way, because it is not synthetic test data at all -- this fixture pins the bug where a written month past 92 was previously reported as SyntheticNumber, a claim about Skatteetaten's test-data marker that is false for this value; the corrected behaviour is ImpossibleDate. generated.csv's fnr-499-000 row, individual 306 (day 12, month 13, year 1990 as fed to the generator -- digits chosen to decode to no calendar date at all, not a real birth date).
